rationale: The candidate is a coherent single gesture in all four views: a continuous bent ribbon-like mass with a clear dominant form and good silhouette continuity. However, for a gymnasium the program contract requires one legible long-span hall plus subordinate support/entry logic and a daylight roof expression. Here, the visible mass is too uniform and horizontal; it reads more like an abstract curved bar than a clear hall enclosing a usable span. There is essentially no public void, court, undercut, entry seam, or other ground response on the access edge, so the road-frontage response is weak. The section/roof logic is also not strongly programmatic enough to confirm clear-span hall behavior. As a massing object it is strong, but as a gymnasium it does not yet hard-pass program fit.
